name: FarShore
note: The Far Shore: a cliff-edged plateau over a sea of mist, cut east-west by the dry, pale bed of the river of the dead. South bank: the Ferry Landing (spawn, select lantern, safe zone) with a pier over the dry bed and a torii before the stone bridge. Centre: the riverbed, the main arena, with stranded boats and cairns for cover and the bridge overhead. West reach: the Jizo Beach, a pebble bar in a cove (no PvP, five phase dummies). South-east: the Lily Fields on a low hill. North bank: the Elder's Grove on a gentle rise, with barrows to the west and a pine bluff to the east. Authored at spec heights; volume.lift raises everything by 8 in game. Parts on terrain sit at the terrain height (pads are flat; smooth terrain surfaces about 2 studs above the heightfield). This is the greybox: no part carries a mesh yet, because T9 judges a dressed map as a whole; dressing_plan lists what replaces what in section 3. Build the final layout against the references below, never from imagination. Run: python scripts/build_map.py <this spec>

references.for: Jizo Beach and the riverbed stones
references.subject: Osorezan's Sai no Kawara (Aomori): barren pale stone fields, stacked cairns, pinwheels, red-bibbed Jizo statues
Kinchakuda spider-lily fields (Hidaka, Saitama): carpets of red spider lilies under trees at the autumn equinox
Meganebashi (Nagasaki): a low double-arched stone bridge over a shallow river
a dry gravel riverbed with beached wooden boats
public-domain Edo-period ukiyo-e landscape prints at dusk

theme_plan: Section 3 runs theme.py extract on the downloaded references to make themes/far_shore.json, then sets "theme" here. Until then the spec names no theme, so the blockout builds without one.
look: Eternal dusk: a low sun in the west behind the mist, teal-grey fog, bloom on lilies and lanterns, warm highlights and cool shadows; Lighting.Technology Future. Terrain colours: Grass a dusky olive, Limestone bone-pale, Mud dark red-brown.

volume.note: A fall off any cliff reaches the kill plane in about a second; the ring-out fires at killPlane + ringOutOffset and is credited to the last hitter.

terrain.note_tide: The tide sits below the sea floor on purpose: the river has run dry and the edge is a sea of mist (Atmosphere), not water.

materialZones.why: the dry riverbed floor and low banks read bone-pale against the crimson lilies

intent.note: Every zone is walkable from the landing: the banks stay under 22 degrees, the bridge has ramps at both ends, the beach cove opens onto the bed.

sightlines.note: An open brawler: long sightlines over the riverbed are intended for zoners; the boats, cairns, bridge pier and the hills break them.

open_edges: By design. The Far Shore is a plateau over a sea of mist: its cliffs and the two dry falls where the riverbed meets the edge are the ring-out boundary, and a fall is a death credited to the last hitter within 10 s. Barrier walls would remove the genre's ring-out play, so there are none.
